_comment: Server-controlled qualification registry. Autonomy for model-dependent judgment requires a configuration whose status is 'qualified' and revoked is false. Absence or status 'failed' means human review. The failed llama3.1:8b entry is kept deliberately: it records what was tested and why it does not authorize autonomy.

configurations.limitations: 17/18 determinate under V1 and 18/19 under V3; invented APPROVE on Amount 0; stable Q-021 (blank Region) error; failing safe abstention.

scope.task_policy: Approve Open records with Amount >= 100 and Risk Low. Review Open records with Amount 50-99 or Risk High. Deny Closed records. Exception: North region with Risk High requires Review even when Amount >= 100.
